item.title: Hotspotly 0.6.0
item.description:
• Insights. Settings… → Insights compares latency, packet loss and drops with AWDL off and on, lists recent drops with their cause, and counts what Hotspotly did.
  • A helper instead of the sudoers rule. Allow it once under System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions; after that nothing asks for a password.
  • Permissions at a glance in Settings… → General, with buttons to the right place in System Settings.
  • Mobile hotspots in the Networks tab: a Type column, and Mark as Mobile Hotspot for the selection. Turn Off AWDL moved to General.
  • Pinning works on macOS 26 again, joining through CoreWLAN.
  • Move to Applications when opened from Downloads, and Uninstall now trashes the app.
  • Routers that ignore pings, common on planes and in hotels, no longer show a red light.

After updating, choose Allow Hotspotly’s Helper… in the menu.
